rca:flags.text: Reference .cnv was processed with datcnv only; alignctd / celltm / loopedit are not applied.

The .cnv holds the downcast only (12015 scans, 11731 kept after removing ship-heave reversals). Bottle (.btl) averages are taken at upcast bottle closures, so CTD-vs-Autosal uses upcast data while profiler-vs-CTD uses the downcast.

Bottle salinity is taken from the cruise's discrete summary (the laboratory's Autosal and cast-log workbooks are not available for this cruise); replicates are averaged and the summary's flags are applied.
Niskin 9 (CTD-011 Niskin 9, ~141 m depSM, sal00): CTD-bottle -0.0136 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.010 PSU/m.
Niskin 9 (CTD-011 Niskin 9, ~141 m depSM, sal11): CTD-bottle -0.0135 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.010 PSU/m.
